test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Allimony**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is '**Alimony**'. • **Alimony **refers to the financial support paid by one spouse to another after a divorce. (तलाक के बाद एक पति या पत्नी द्वारा दूसरे को दी जाने वाली वित्तीय सहायता) • **Example**: *He pays alimony monthly to his ex-wife as part of the divorce settlement.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Structural **is spelled correctly. It means relating to the structure of something. (किसी चीज़ की संरचना) • **Hallucinate **is spelled correctly. It means to experience something that is not real. (कुछ ऐसा अनुभव करें जो वास्तविक नहीं है) • **Halloween **is spelled correctly. It is a holiday celebrated on October 31st. (31 अक्टूबर को मनाया जाने वाला अवकाश) 157:Ta18, The correct answer is: **Sensible**.
